title: Compat matrix points at nonexistent src/tests and unsupported Python
evidence: python-compatibility.yml:9-21,40-46 filters paths src/** and tests/** and sets source-directory 'src' but repo has no top-level src/ or tests/; matrix includes Python 3.12/3.13 while pyproject pins >=3.10,<3.12.
recommendation: Point source-directory, path filters, and test command at DeQA-Score/; drop 3.12/3.13 until torch upgrade.

title: Production code linted only by local pre-commit, never in CI
evidence: ruff on DeQA-Score/src/uncertainty/ exists only in .pre-commit-config.yaml:79-88; no workflow runs pre-commit (grep empty); CI ruff targets results/ only.
recommendation: Add a blocking CI job running pre-commit run --all-files or scoped ruff on src/uncertainty/.

title: Documented 'from src import Scorer' raises AttributeError
evidence: CLAUDE.md:42 and README.md:103 show 'from src import Scorer'; src/__init__.py __getattr__ returns only MPLUGOwl2LlamaForCausalLM and raises AttributeError otherwise; Scorer is in src/evaluate/scorer.py:14.
recommendation: Re-export Scorer in src/__init__.py or fix both docs to 'from src.evaluate.scorer import Scorer'.

title: Dimension name split: color vs color_fidelity
evidence: research/papers/shared/constants.py:18 uses 'color_fidelity'; pseudo_label.py:27, siglip2_v2_model.py:30, run_sweep.py:48, results/siglip2_v2_pseudo_label_validation/*.py use 'color'. Dicts keyed on one spelling miss the other.
recommendation: Add canonical DIMENSIONS to src/constants.py (use 'color'), import everywhere, fix the color_fidelity spelling.

title: Quality-level constants re-declared in 9+ modules
evidence: LEVEL_NAMES = [excellent,good,fair,poor,bad] redefined verbatim in 7+ modules outside src/constants.py:16, which already exports it and is imported by the core.
recommendation: Import LEVEL_NAMES/LEVEL_PREFIX from src.constants in the satellite modules and delete local copies.

title: No real coverage measurement despite a coverage pipeline
evidence: coverage.yml:30-33 downloads coverage-reports/coverage.xml on CI success but ci.yml runs no pytest and uploads no coverage artifact; python-compatibility.yml:46 sets coverage-report:false. No coverage figure exists.
recommendation: Run the non-torch test subset in CI with pytest --cov and upload coverage.xml, or remove coverage.yml.

title: Core ML stack pinned to 2-3 year old releases
recommendation: Keep pins (required/documented) but track the model-stack migration as a dated epic, not an open deferral.

title: torch 2.0.1 caps runtime at Python 3.11 / CUDA 11.8
evidence: pyproject.toml:11 requires-python >=3.10,<3.12; torch 2.0.1 cu118 wheels only for py3.8-3.11. Python 3.10 EOL 2026-10 (~5 months out). CUDA 11.8 two generations behind.
recommendation: Plan the 3.12 move with the torch upgrade; do not let 3.10 reach EOL as the floor. Document CUDA 11.8 in README.

title: Vendored transformers internals coupled to the transformers==4.36.1 pin
evidence: modeling_llama2.py:14-23,35 imports private transformers.models.llama symbols and does 'import *'; :859 monkeypatches LlamaFlashAttention2; modeling_attn_mask_utils.py is a verbatim HF copy. pyproject.toml:18 pins transformers==4.36.1; any bump breaks these.
recommendation: Record the exact transformers version these internals track in a code comment; do not unvendor without re-running training.

title: research/ocr_iqa_correlation has no lockfile
evidence: No research/ocr_iqa_correlation/uv.lock; ranged deps (jiwer>=3.0, datasets>=2.14, docling>=2.0, google-cloud-vision>=3.0) make builds non-reproducible.
recommendation: Run uv lock and commit the lockfile, or fold deps into a root optional extra.

title: sys.path.insert import hack in vendored model loader
evidence: modeling_llama2.py:30-31 inserts dir into sys.path before a try/except relative import of .modeling_attn_mask_utils; the relative import already works, making the insert redundant.
recommendation: Remove the redundant sys.path insert if the file is ever touched.

title: No git-history secret scan and no detect-secrets baseline
evidence: .pre-commit-config.yaml:34-40 trufflehog scans staged files only; CI uses a regex grep not a scanner; no .secrets.baseline exists. A secret committed earlier or in a missed file type is not caught.
recommendation: Add a CI job running trufflehog/gitleaks in full-history mode on push to main.

title: CI ruff/bandit gates are advisory-only
evidence: ci.yml ruff-format, ruff-lint, and bandit steps end in '|| echo "::warning::"', so failures become annotations and the job still passes. Only the secret grep and .env check can fail.
recommendation: Drop the '|| echo' fallback on at least the ruff lint step so lint regressions block merge.

title: Redundant coverage uploaders consuming a missing artifact
evidence: coverage.yml:18-33 and qlty.yml:13-27 both trigger on workflow_run CI completed and both call python-qlty-coverage.yml with coverage-artifact-name coverage-reports; CI produces no such artifact.
recommendation: Delete one workflow; make the survivor depend on a CI step that emits coverage.xml.

title: Contradictory CodeQL setup instructions
evidence: ci.yml comment says default setup handles CodeQL and forbids an advanced config; codeql.yml is an advanced config (init+analyze, security-extended) and says default setup must be DISABLED. The two cannot both hold.
recommendation: Confirm default setup is disabled and delete the stale contradicting comment in ci.yml.

title: Mutable @main reference for a reusable workflow
evidence: qlty.yml:14 and coverage.yml:26 reference python-qlty-coverage.yml@main (mutable) while compatibility/security/scorecard workflows pin their org reusable workflows to a SHA.
recommendation: Pin the qlty/coverage reusable workflow to a commit SHA and let Renovate bump it.

title: Documented GEMINI_API_KEY unused; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY undocumented
evidence: CLAUDE.md:157 says VLM scripts require GEMINI_API_KEY; git grep GEMINI in *.py returns 0. Code reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, GCP_SA_KEY, GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, ADOBE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET.
recommendation: Update CLAUDE.md and .env.example to the env vars the code reads; remove or wire up GEMINI_API_KEY.

title: Prior review report reads as live but findings persist
evidence: PROJECT_REVIEW_REPORT.md dated 2026-03-09 claims 8 critical/10 high and names constants-in-5-7-locations as top finding; still present 2.5 months later (ARCH-01/02). No resolution-status column.
recommendation: Add a status column or date each finding's state, or move the report under docs/audit/.

title: Llamafactory patch-apply process underdocumented
evidence: CLAUDE.md describes Llamafactory/ files as patches to copy into a LLaMA-Factory install but gives no target commit and no apply steps; the Qwen backend is not reproducible from this.
recommendation: Add the pinned LLaMA-Factory commit and a copy/apply command to the Qwen section of CLAUDE.md.

title: Manual transitive-floor list with no automated check
evidence: pyproject.toml:30-50 pins 11 transitive security floors by hand (idna, pillow, GitPython, h11, certifi, pygments, requests, starlette, urllib3, filelock). No automated check keeps the list ahead of new advisories.
recommendation: Add a scheduled osv-scanner/pip-audit job against uv.lock to flag when a new floor is needed.

title: Duplicated experiment-harness scaffolding
evidence: Repeated main() bodies (arg parse, env load, model x image loop, JSON write, markdown table) across results/vlm_teacher_eval/run_eval.py, full_eval/run_full_diqa_eval.py, research/vlm_calibration/evaluate_calibration.py; reset_parameters monkeypatch copied in modal/benchmark_synthetic_ood.py:707-708 and run_deqa_ocr_iqa.py:271-272.
recommendation: Extract a shared runner if more eval arms are coming; otherwise accept the duplication.

title: Satellite tiers reach the core via 35 sys.path inserts
evidence: git grep counts 35 sys.path.insert/append in new code; run_sweep.py:39-43 inserts a path then imports from src.uncertainty with # noqa: E402. The core is not installed as a package.
recommendation: Install DeQA-Score as an editable package in the research/modal environments so imports resolve without path hacks.

title: Qwen backend relies on copy-into-install patching, no pinned commit
evidence: CLAUDE.md states Llamafactory/ files are patches to copy into a LLaMA-Factory install; no pinned upstream version and no apply step. Patches break silently if upstream refactors the touched files.
recommendation: Pin the exact LLaMA-Factory commit and add a one-line apply script.

title: High-complexity functions in experiment scripts
evidence: ruff --select C901 (threshold 10) reports 40 functions over the limit, 37 in research/results/modal. Worst: dry_run_check (30), train (27), main (27,24), run_evaluations (23), compute_all_metrics (22), run_deqa_scoring (22). Only 3 are in src/.
recommendation: Refactor the 3 in src/ when next touched; leave the run-once script tier as-is.

title: Pinned dependencies with open CVEs (trusted-input control)
evidence: known-vulnerabilities.md lists 32 transformers advisories and deepspeed RCE GHSA-8cp5-3rf8-8gfh (allowlisted in dependency-review.yml). Reachable only via malicious model/tokenizer files; project loads only its own trusted artifacts.
recommendation: Compensating control holds; keep documented, hold to 2026-07-27 reassessment. Not Critical (no untrusted-input path).

title: No SBOM generated
evidence: No workflow emits CycloneDX/SPDX/syft output; grep matches only reuse.yml (license) and dependency-review.yml (PR diff). No artifact inventories the resolved dependency graph.
recommendation: Add a CycloneDX SBOM step from uv.lock if release provenance matters. Low priority for an internal fork.

title: os.path where pathlib fits (new code)
evidence: Per-dir os.path counts: modal/ 7 hits, uncertainty/ 2; research and results are pathlib-first (0 os.path). Only modal/ and uncertainty/ mix both.
recommendation: Convert residual os.path calls in modal/ and uncertainty/ to pathlib.Path. Upstream exempt.

title: Bare except clauses in upstream inference/data paths
evidence: 3 bare 'except:' at datasets/utils.py:26, iqa_eval.py:100, iqa_eval_qwen.py:126, catching KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit.
recommendation: Narrow to 'except Exception:' if these files are ever modified.

title: '.format()' residue in new code
evidence: Real %-formatting in new code = 0. .format() survives in 5 spots; run_sweep.py:760,923 could be f-strings; the template-based .format() calls (prompts.py:71, format_training_data.py:89) are idiomatic.
recommendation: Optionally convert the two run_sweep.py lines to f-strings; keep template .format() calls.

title: pydantic v1 API (deliberate, documented)
evidence: metadata_schema.py:12 docstring states v1 API for pydantic<2 pin; :24 imports validator; metadata_io.py uses .dict() at 130,147,154,156,162,166,169. pyproject.toml:25 pins pydantic<2 for mPLUG-Owl2.
recommendation: No change now; migrate validator->field_validator and .dict()->.model_dump() when the pin lifts (track with LEG-01).

title: type-ignore/noqa escape hatches (justified)
evidence: 19 type: ignore and 6 noqa, all reason-coded: frozen-dataclass test mutations ([misc]), optional-import stubs in vendored Llamafactory (loader.py:122-142), dict typing in research, E402 after sys.path inserts, one S301 on a self-owned pickle.
recommendation: No action; localized and reason-coded.

title: TODO/FIXME debt small and old
evidence: 14 markers total, 10 in vendored upstream. Oldest actionable: train_mem.py:488 'TODO I dont like auto resume << REMOVE IT' dates to 2025-07-10 (~10.5 months). modal/benchmark_synthetic_ood.py:1087 is the only new-code marker.
recommendation: Resolve or delete the train_mem.py:488 auto-resume TODO; upstream markers stay.

title: Assert-based validation in data/inference paths
evidence: ruff S101 reports 88 asserts; most are in tests. 3 are control-flow asserts in data/inference paths (pair_dataset.py:125, single_dataset.py:79, mm_utils.py:101) that python -O strips.
recommendation: Raise explicit exceptions instead of asserts in the 3 data-path sites. Low risk (training rarely uses -O).

title: eval() on a path component in weight conversion
evidence: convert_mplug_owl2_weight_to_hf.py:118 uses eval(input_base_path.split('/')[-1]...) on a local checkpoint dir name (ruff S307). Operator-controlled input, low injection risk.
recommendation: Replace with int(...) or ast.literal_eval. Change only if touched.

title: requests calls without timeout
evidence: ruff S113 flags 3 requests calls without timeout= at eval_qbench_mcq.py:32, iqa_eval.py:30, iqa_eval_qwen.py:26. A hung server stalls eval.
recommendation: Add timeout= (e.g. 30s) to each call.

title: pickle.load on a cache file
evidence: evaluate_calibration.py:139 'return pickle.load(f) # noqa: S301' on a self-written calibration cache. Self-owned input; a tampered cache deserializes arbitrary objects.
recommendation: Acceptable for a self-written cache; switch to JSON/npz if the cache is ever shared.

title: harden-runner pinned to two different versions
evidence: step-security/harden-runner at SHA a5ad31d6 (v2.19.1) in ci.yml/reuse.yml and 91182ccc (v2.10.1) in codeql.yml/security-analysis.yml. Version drift on a security action.
recommendation: Align all harden-runner uses to one SHA; let Renovate's grouping keep them together.

title: typing.List/Dict generics instead of builtins (new code)
evidence: Counts of List[/Dict[/Optional[/Tuple[/Union[: new uncertainty=59 (actionable); upstream model=91, Llamafactory=92 (exempt). Runtime 3.11 supports list[], dict[], X | None.
recommendation: For new code only, prefer builtin generics and X | None; the 59 hits in uncertainty/ are the target.

title: research/ and results/ overlap in purpose
evidence: Both hold experiment runners plus outputs (results/vlm_teacher_eval/run_eval.py and research/vlm_calibration/evaluate_calibration.py are both eval drivers; both mix .py with .json/.csv/.png). The boundary is not stated in CLAUDE.md.
recommendation: Document the intended split in CLAUDE.md or merge them. Low priority while work is active.

title: Broad except Exception handlers (43 sites)
evidence: git grep -c 'except Exception' returns 43; 0 are 'except: pass' swallow blocks, so sampled handlers log or re-raise. Breadth is the concern, not silent swallowing.
recommendation: No bulk change; narrow exception types in new code when a handler is edited.

title: No ADRs for load-bearing decisions
evidence: docs/architecture/ holds strategy docs and PlantUML diagrams but no ADR records for the pydantic<2 pin, the gradio removal, the two-backend split, or the uncertainty-pipeline design. Rationale lives partly in CHANGELOG and known-vulnerabilities.md.
recommendation: Add short ADRs for the pin policy and two-backend split. Low priority.
